text_block_list.text:
It seemed that Sirius Symboli had once 
been a truly unique, irreplaceable 
presence to Symboli Rudolf as well.

However, for the dream of "Happiness to 
all Umamusume," Symboli Rudolf cast aside 
her "special" status, her ferocity, and 
her merciless running.

Sirius Symboli used to aim for the 
beast-like Symboli Rudolf of the past, but 
she says that is no longer the case.

Perhaps Sirius Symboli wanted her to get 
back her fangs after she had pulled them— 
None but Sirius herself will ever know the 
answer.
